artigo.titulo: Why is my jade plant wrinkled or dropping leaves?

legenda: Wrinkled jade leaves can mean thirst or too much water, and falling leaves can mean cold. Squeeze a leaf and check the soil before you water.

beats.texto: Wrinkled jade leaves?! Don't water it yet!
Relax! Wrinkles can mean two opposite things.
Thin leaves and dry soil?! It's thirsty.
Soft, dark leaves and a soft stem?! Too much water.
Leaves dropping after a cold night?! It got too cold.
So squeeze a leaf and check the soil first.
Dry right through?! Water deeply, then empty the saucer.
Light and season change everything. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
